title: The Enclave
text: The Survivors: descendants of the first Accord run (the damaged log at the bottom of the Deep Layer is their caretaker's), who hid from their caretaker in a cut through the Deep Layer's crater rim. Speaker: Sefa. In Act 1 she tells only what her people saw (the fire, the doors shut) and gives the code to the Lid; her recording's second track, which opens once the Ledger is read, names the Clause and what wakes it.
